name: Cross-Dog Creeper Sim Pressure
formation: Nickel Odd Over vs 11P Gun 2x2 Spread

summary.motive: Generate unblocked pressure with a 4-man simulated rush by replacing a dropping defensive end with a blitzing linebacker into the offense’s slide protection.
summary.keyDefender: WILL (Creeper Linebacker Rusher) & WDE (Dropping Defensive End)
summary.whyItWorks: The offensive line slides protection to the defensive end who bails, while failing to account for the linebacker shooting the opposite B-gap from second-level depth.
summary.failureMode: A designed perimeter quarterback rollout away from the creeper rush that isolates cornerbacks in man/zone match without edge contain.

beats.title: Mug Front Sim Pressure Alignment
beats.text: Spagnuolo presents a 5-man line of scrimmage front with MIKE mugged in the A-gap, signaling an all-out pass rush to force 5-man slide protection.

beats.title: The Creeper Exchange
beats.text: At the snap, only 4 defenders rush! Defensive end WDE drops into the shallow hook zone while inside linebacker WILL shoots the strong B-gap on a creeper blitz.

beats.title: Hot Window Clogged by Defensive End
beats.text: The QB expects the blitz and looks to hit H on the shallow crossing hot route, only to find the 260-pound WDE standing directly in the throwing window.

beats.title: Unblocked Creeper Sacks Quarterback
beats.text: With his primary hot route taken away by the dropping defensive lineman, the QB is brought down by WILL blazing through the vacated B-gap.

relations.tell: Defensive end steps back into hook drop at snap while off-ball linebacker triggers forward into B-gap
